assumptions: Every equivalent full chunk has the modeled uniform routes. Each saved packed request is a DRAM miss transferred at peak. The 0.43 s conversion counts saved weights alone. The full-box activation calculation charges all rows including tile padding. Its break-even ratio assumes each extra A byte and each removed weight byte has a fixed DRAM miss fraction. Actual cache hits, out-of-bounds zero fill, issue work, residency, imbalance and overlap can change the result. This is a units conversion, not a performance bound or forecast.
